figurative_meaning_en: Oppression or bullying of the weak
similar_in_english: Kick a man when he's down
The strong preying on the weak
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় নরমে গরম করে, দুর্বলদের উপর জুলুম করে।
সমাজে নরমে গরমের প্রথা চলতে থাকলে কখনো উন্নতি হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He always heats the soft, bullying those who are vulnerable.
In society, if the practice of oppressing the weak continues, there will never be progress.
note: This idiom reflects common social dynamics in Bengali culture where the powerful exploit the vulnerable.
